faq.subtitle: Core guidance for day-to-day agronomic decisions on CROP AI

thresholds.question: How does CROP calculate the 3 Outbreak Risk Thresholds?
thresholds.answer: Risk levels are calculated by tracking Growing Degree Day (GDD) accumulation against species-specific emergence thresholds, using live weather data and satellite vegetation health (NDVI) to forecast pest activity before it occurs.

species.question: Why does the platform only track 3 specific insect species?
species.answer: CROP is calibrated on three high-impact pests - Tuta absoluta, Bemisia tabaci and Ceratitis capitata - because each needs its own thermal thresholds and monitoring method. More species are added only after local validation.

refresh.question: How often are Sentinel-2 and Drone NDVI maps refreshed?
refresh.answer: Sentinel-2 imagery is checked daily and a new NDVI map appears about every 5 days when the sky is cloud-free. Drone NDVI uploads are processed immediately.

Low.title: Low Risk (<40%)
Low.action: Routine scouting and baseline perimeter pheromone patrols.

Mid.title: Mid Risk (40–69%)
Mid.action: Recommend farmer deploy yellow sticky traps and increase scouting frequency.

High.title: High Risk (≥70%)
High.action: Mandatory biological intervention (Bt spray / Encarsia release).
